name: cluster
note: 6 base facts that are all about ONE thing — a single local-inference deployment — so every cross-base pair is a SAME-TOPIC, different-subject sample. The builtin corpus deliberately has none of these: its 12 subjects are mutually unrelated, so its UNRELATED class is entirely cross-topic and a merge threshold measured on it is unvalidated for the region a real memory scope actually occupies. A live store that lost two facts to a bad merge looked exactly like this: a dozen facts about one llama.cpp/ROCm box. Run this corpus alongside the builtin one; if max(UNRELATED) here is higher, the recommendation from the builtin corpus alone is too permissive for your store. Same layout as the builtin corpus, so copy and edit it for your own dense topic.
